integrity: The proof uses the published complete splitting classification, an explicit count of rational points on a nonsingular conic, and the direct-sum count of complementary unital subalgebras. A package-local checker directly verifies every predicted operator in several finite fields and exhausts all endomorphisms over both form classes in the smallest odd field.
scientific_limitations: The count is for the three-dimensional simple Jordan algebra of a nondegenerate bilinear form and fixed nonzero Rota–Baxter weight.
The zeta function is the extension-field point-count zeta function; no finer scheme-theoretic singularity claim is made.
title: Exact nonzero-weight Rota–Baxter counts on \(J_3(f)\) over finite fields
